# jamfplatform_pro_policy (Data Source)

Look up a Jamf Pro policy by ID or by exact name. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be supplied. Surfaces a flat read-only projection of the most-frequently looked-up fields; manage the policy as a resource for full detail.

**Required Jamf permissions**

Create the API integration with **Platform environment** scope (preferred) or **Tenant** scope, then grant it the following permissions in Jamf Account — see [Getting started with the Platform API](https://developer.jamf.com/platform-api/reference/getting-started-with-platform-api). `Category` and `Permission` name the section and row of the permission picker; `Actions` are the boxes to tick within that row.

| Category | Permission | Actions | API capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| Deployment | Policies | Read | `policies` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a policy by exact name.
data "jamfplatform_pro_policy" "by_name" {
  name = "tf-acc-minimal-policy"
}

output "policy_id" {
  value = data.jamfplatform_pro_policy.by_name.id
}

# Look up a policy by ID.
data "jamfplatform_pro_policy" "by_id" {
  id = "42"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Policy ID. Mutually exclusive with `name`.
- `name` (String) Policy display name (exact match). Mutually exclusive with `id`.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `category_id` (String) Category ID.
- `category_name` (String) Category display name.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the policy is enabled.
- `frequency` (String) Policy frequency.
- `site_id` (String) Site ID. `-1` means no site.
- `site_name` (String) Site display name.
- `trigger` (String) Aggregate trigger label.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
